27:21.en: 「No escape... for you, or for me.」

27:524.en: 「It's for you, and for me too.」

27:732.en: 「$$シュロウガ$$'s eye will soon see you...」

27:817.en: 「Come at me as often as you like.」

27:867.en: 「What are you trying to take from me?」

27:900.en: 「What did you even want to do?」

27:1175.en: 「So... what do you plan to do next?」

27:1264.en: 「You do seem to have some power.」

27:1299.en: 「Some of my armor got stripped away.」

27:1361.en: 「$$シュロウガ$$ seems to be warming up.」

27:1433.en: 「Heh... Glad to meet prey like you.」

27:1542.en: 「How about it, $$シュロウガ$$?\nQuite impressive, isn't it?」

27:1593.en: 「Yes, just like that.\nShow me you can hurt me...!」

27:1789.en: 「Do you laugh at how base I am?」

27:1818.en: 「Cursed wanderers...\nThat is the name for you and me.」

27:1906.en: 「Is it you who seeks? Or is it me?」

27:1976.en: 「The end of myth... Where is it?」

27:2081.en: 「Behold...\n$$シュロウガ$$, stained with deeper sin.」

27:2204.en: 「Even endless travel has a dead stop.」

27:2293.en: 「The Heavenly Prison...\nIt is this dead planet itself.」

27:2454.en: 「What hue is the future to your eyes?」

27:2495.en: 「Light and dark melt together in you.」

27:2524.en: 「Beings not allowed to die...\nYou and I are the same.」

27:2573.en: 「At $$シンカ$$'s end, what do you see?」

27:2697.en: 「$$始原の特異点$$... What can you do?」

27:2734.en: 「I have no need of your song.」

27:2759.en: 「Even gold wings can't cut the dark.」

27:2829.en: 「On the day all worlds end,\nwhat will you see?」

27:3084.en: 「Can your fire burn up my causality?」

27:3205.en: 「A breaker of the natural order, huh.」

27:3222.en: 「The weight of the freedom you won...\nI'd like you to tell me.」

27:3304.en: 「$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$... Farewell to you as well.」

27:3345.en: 「$$シュロウガ$$ and I want you as offering.」

27:3384.en: 「I want it, the glow of your $$スフィア$$.」

27:3421.en: 「I'll grant your wish in your place.」

27:3491.en: 「$$セツコ$$...\nYour tears are my water of life.」

27:3583.en: 「$$ランド$$...\nShow me you enduring the pain.」

27:3632.en: 「Pain makes you and your $$スフィア$$ glow.」

27:3714.en: 「That unshakable will...\nHow far can it take you?」

27:3769.en: 「I won't hand you over to $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

27:3940.en: 「Before the universe's curtain falls,\nI'll set you free.」

27:4026.en: 「In their place, I give you despair.」

27:4105.en: 「Allow me to have a go as well.」

27:4284.en: 「Come in after $$シュロウガ・シン$$.」

27:4425.en: 「$$シュロウガ・シン$$ isn't there.」

27:4528.en: 「You are far removed from the truth.」

27:4722.en: 「"Rabble" is the word for you all.」

27:4850.en: 「You don't seem to want to fight.」

27:4910.en: 「What I want to see is beyond that.」

27:4983.en: 「The darkness is still just as black.」

27:5035.en: 「$$シュロウガ・シン$$ is delighted too.」

27:5138.en: 「Being able to feel pain is a joy.」

27:5171.en: 「I'm at the line of hope and despair.」

27:5206.en: 「Heh... heh heh... heh heh heh heh...」

27:5235.en: 「The abyss waits, jaws open, for us.」

27:5276.en: 「To black beyond dark, void beyond depth...」

27:5342.en: 「So this is the power of the sun.」

27:5417.en: 「You and I seem alike, yet we differ.」

27:5450.en: 「I see...\nYou're trying to open the door.」

27:5532.en: 「The blood of the beast lives in you.」

27:5664.en: 「I see. The Demon God of Light, then.」

27:5697.en: 「Beyond the void, beyond time,\nand beyond causality.」

27:5905.en: 「Will your wings overcome\n12,000 years of fate?」

27:5954.en: 「I see... A flame to burn even fate.」

27:6008.en: 「Spiral to the sky, me to darkness.」

27:6183.en: 「The 12 keys shine ever brighter...\nI crave them...!」

27:6808.en: 「I'll crush the ties that bind me!」

27:7058.en: 「No truth for you! No $$太極$$!\nYou'll never reach myth's end!!」

27:7121.en: 「...I'll make it there,\nthis time too... to that gate.」
